How it works

Three steps, no runaround

01

Call or send a request

Call or text 305-306-6391, or use the request form below. Say what the boat is doing — or not doing — and where it’s berthed.

02

Your technician comes to the boat

The visit happens at your dock or marina. Faults are traced on board, options and parts are quoted before any work beyond the diagnostic begins.

03

Fixed, tested, in writing

The system is tested end to end before the job is called done, and you receive a written record of what was found and what was done.
